title: Sam Darnold takes responsibility for Seahawks' loss at Denver: 'It's BS for me to keep turning the ball over'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sam Darnold takes responsibility for Seahawks' loss at Denver: 'It's BS for me to keep turning the ball over'
sources.description: The Seahawks fell 17-14 in overtime after Darnold's second interception of the game.
